jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform
